summary: RGB10A2-style signed packed-texture vertex decoder. Computes a source texel pointer from this+0x18 plus this+0x1050 (row) and this+0x1054 (slice) pitch products with the two index arguments, then loops over this+0x1058 texels. Each packed 32-bit texel is sign-extended into three 10-bit channels (alpha bits [30:21], first channel bits [9:0], second channel bits [19:10]) via arithmetic-shift tricks, scaled by constants 0.001953125 (2^-9) and 0.0009765625 (2^-10), and written as four floats (three channels plus a constant 1.0). When the this+0x10 flag is non-zero, ContactManifoldCleanup is called on the decoded float output.

operations.description: Compute source texel pointer v4 = this+0x18 + a3 * this+0x1054 + a2 * this+0x1050 (slice and row pitch products with the index arguments).
For-loop iterating over this+0x1058 packed 32-bit texels from v4 up to v4 + this+0x1058; each iteration consumes one dword and emits one 4-float RGBA texel.
Sign-extend alpha channel: v7 = (__int16)(32 * (*v4 >> 21)) >> 5, recovering a signed 10-bit value from bits [30:21].
Sign-extend first color channel: v8 = (double)((__int16)(*(_WORD *)v4 << 6) >> 6), recovering a signed 10-bit value from bits [9:0].
Sign-extend second color channel: v9 = (__int16)(32 * (*v4 >> 10)) >> 5, recovering a signed 10-bit value from bits [19:10].

Write four output floats per texel: a4[0] = v8 * 0.001953125, a4[1] = v9 * 0.0009765625, a4[2] = v7 * 0.0009765625, a4[3] = 1.0 (alpha set via the loop increment). The scale factors correspond to the two read-only globals flt_59E4D8 and flt_5ACF38.
Guard: if this+0x10 is non-zero, post-process the decoded float output.
Call ContactManifoldCleanup((int)this, &a4[-4 * this+0x1058]) on the decoded float RGBA output buffer start.
